confirmed_findings.statement: Two Ripple-owned escrow objects totaling 1B XRP have FinishAfter 2026-11-01T00:00Z at ledger 108028302, closed 2026-10-31T18:03Z.
Prior 12 releases: 12B released, 8.4B re-escrowed (70%), 3.6B net outside escrow; October 2026 was 1B released, 700M re-escrowed, 300M net.
Coinbase/Ripple announced RLUSD access on Prime, Exchange, Retail with XRPL/Base/Ethereum deposits/withdrawals; Ripple Base liquidity; Global Exchange collateral deferred.
Deloitte Sep30 report: 2,399,995,528 RLUSD outstanding; $2,524,008,274 reserves; opinion fairly stated in all material respects.
Ripple live page displays $2.627B circulation and $2.7586B reserves as of Oct29; not the Sep30 attestation.
XRP Insights, stables.cool and XRPL.to report about 707.4M RLUSD on XRPL; Ethereum about 1.71B; sources are correlated.

company_claims.statement: Binance claims 90% total replenishment and 100% backing for ten assets including XRP; full ZK proof estimated by Nov3.

conflicting_observations.statement: XR-Lineage displayed 910.3M RLUSD at 13:52:19Z and 2,000 trustlines, about 202.9M above the 707.4M cluster.
Oct31 two-chain dashboard total near $2.42B differs from Ripple's Oct29 global issuer display $2.627B; dates/network scope differ.

inferences: If 70% re-escrow repeats, Nov1 1B release implies 700M re-escrow and 300M net outside escrow; scenario only.
Coinbase three-network access creates a plausible distribution channel, but no transaction crosswalk proves XRPL decline migrated to Coinbase-supported chains.
Chain-specific RLUSD decline does not establish global redemption or net capital leaving Ripple's stablecoin system.
unknowns: Whether and when Nov1 escrow objects are finished.
Where released XRP goes and how much is re-escrowed or sold.
Raw XR-Lineage query and meaning of 2,000 trustlines.
Aligned RLUSD supply/bridge flows on Base, Optimism, Ink, Unichain and XRPL EVM.
Whether Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral is live; Oct28 announcement said deferred.
disconfirming_evidence: Prior 12 releases re-escrowed 70%; 1B scheduled does not imply 1B sell pressure.
Deloitte Sep30 and Ripple Oct29 show reserves above outstanding/circulation, but dates/assurance differ.
Three 707.4M dashboards are correlated; XR-Lineage is an outlier with a different trustline count.
Coinbase explicitly deferred Global Exchange RLUSD collateral.

event_timeline.event: Coinbase/Ripple RLUSD distribution announcement; XRPL/Base/Ethereum; Base liquidity; Global Exchange collateral deferred.
Ripple transparency page displays $2.627B circulation and $2.7586B reserves.
Pinned XRPL ledger 108028302 shows next 1B Ripple escrow FinishAfter at 2026-11-01T00:00Z.
Two Ripple escrow objects totaling 1B XRP become eligible for EscrowFinish; actual transaction/disposition remains to be observed.
Binance stated target date for phased withdrawal reopening; not verified.
Binance stated estimated date for full ZK PoR proof; not guaranteed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Nov1 1B unlock repeats recent 70% re-escrow pattern, leaving about 300M net outside escrow.
disconfirming: Historical pattern is not contractual; amount/timing may change.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Observe EscrowFinish/EscrowCreate at pinned ledgers after 00:00Z.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Some XRPL RLUSD decline after Oct28 reflects allocation to Coinbase-supported Ethereum/Base rather than global redemption.
support: Coinbase added XRPL/Base/Ethereum access; Ripple announced Base liquidity; Ethereum supply rose in the captured window.
disconfirming: Ethereum increase smaller than XRPL decrease; Base and bridge/mint paths not reconciled; dates/scopes differ.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Reconcile per-chain balances, NTT transfers, burns/mints and Coinbase deposit/withdrawal labels at aligned timestamps.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Some XRPL RLUSD decline reflects redemptions/burns rather than chain migration.
support: RLUSD supply follows deposits/redemptions; XRPL supply is reported lower.
disconfirming: Ripple Oct29 global issuer display exceeds Sep30 attested circulation, though dates differ; no burn IDs matched.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Trace issuer redemption flows and all chain balances over same 24h.

competing_hypotheses.claim: XR-Lineage 910.3M is a tracked-wallet/sample metric, stale display or scope error.
support: XR-Lineage shows 2,000 trustlines vs XRPL.to 101,560; three other providers cluster near 707.4M.
disconfirming: XR-Lineage labels figure live supply; raw scope unknown.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Obtain raw API response and compare canonical issuer gateway_balances at same ledger.
